heading: Thursday, August 21, 2025
topLine: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V3.1 hybrid reasoning model.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V3.1 hybrid reasoning model
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3.1 combines thinking and non-thinking modes in one model, with 128K context and post-training aimed at tool use and multi-step agent tasks; DeepSeek claims gains on SWE and Terminal-Bench. Base and post-trained weights are on Hugging Face, and the API's deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner now map to its two modes.
